reasoning: Global settings are constructor-assigned immutables or constants. Each clone is created with a fixed implementation and initialized atomically through a factory-only, one-shot path; exhaustive assignment searches found no later configuration write. Inherited ERC-721 mutations affect ticket ownership and approvals, while other entrypoints affect lifecycle or accounting state, not configuration. No administrative framework, implementation-slot writer, target-changing caller, or destruction/upgrade entrypoint is reachable, so the invariant is implemented on every supplied path.
